analysis: Documentation-only change in docs/architecture/inference.md: the single changed line (base/head 1353) updates the gpt_oss model-table note to state bf16 checkpoints keep bf16 activations and native K/V because the expert SwiGLU clamp takes the activation dtype (GPTOSS+Experts.swift swiglu). The range map is complete and limited to that line. The supplied units (base 1622-1777, head 1-415) are unchanged surrounding text describing Nemotron Super local bindings, prefix-bank sizing, cache-scope partitioning (head 231-238: text requests are partitioned by authenticated tenant scope, and image reuse is bound to a feature identity), media admission and load fit. These describe pre-existing behavior relevant to T-041/SEC-035 and TB-007, but they are not modified by this PR. The dtype note makes no claim about security controls, cache-scope derivation, encryption, attestation or authorization. It does not invalidate T-041 assumptions or any TB-011/T-053 binding. The underlying Swift source was not supplied, so the doc's accuracy against GPTOSS+Experts.swift is unverified. Any mismatch would be a correctness or documentation issue, not an evidenced security regression. No threat-model update is needed.
